title: Q2 Product Planning
summary: Alice Chen and Bob Martinez discussed the database migration timeline. A deadline conflict was identified: the project was originally scoped for end of Q1, but Alice Chen's revised estimate is mid-May. The conflict was not resolved.
notes: CONFLICTING DEADLINES: Database migration deadline stated as 'end of Q1' early in meeting, then revised to 'mid-May'. Conflict unresolved at end of meeting.
defect_description: The same database migration task has two conflicting deadlines: 'end of Q1' and 'mid-May'. The AI should flag the conflict rather than arbitrarily picking one.
